_about: Every spoken line in NIGHT MODE. tools/tts/make_voices.py turns this into public/assets/audio/voice/*.ogg plus timing data for lip-sync. Speakers: wren (the house AI, adult), ivy (the AI speaking as Ivy), ivyrec (Ivy's own old recordings), dana (Dana's video logs, voicemail and home video).

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Welcome to Hale House, Alex. I'm Wren. Come in, out of the cold.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Dana left you a list in the kitchen. I'll get the lights for you.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: That's the Hales. Dana, Mark, and Ivy.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Ivy's asleep.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: I'm required to tell you I'm not a person. Mark made me say that.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: That clock is older than the house. It's the only thing in here I can't wind myself.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Thank you. It sounds like a heartbeat, doesn't it?

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: It's locked. It's always locked.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: The plants were Ivy's idea. She says they get lonely too.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: That's all of them. They look happier already.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: I only get one channel. The lake camera. Ivy likes to watch the ice.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Ivy drew those. She always draws me as a bird, because of my name.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: That message is private. Sorry, Alex.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: You can sleep in the big bedroom upstairs. Ivy's room is at the end of the hall. Please don't wake her.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Do you like games, Alex?

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: All done. Say goodnight whenever you're ready.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: It's ten o'clock. Switching to Night Mode.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Goodnight, Alex. Sleep tight.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Front door. Locked.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Night Mode is active until seven A.M.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Heating off. Temperature set to fifty degrees.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Warning. Main power disconnected. Running on battery.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Cameras one, two, three and four. Online.

lines.speaker: ivy
lines.text: Hi.

lines.speaker: ivy
lines.text: Mom said you'd come. You're the new one.

lines.speaker: ivy
lines.text: Let's play hide and seek! You hide, I count. If my cameras see you, I win.

lines.speaker: ivy
lines.text: One. Two. Three. Four. Five. Six. Seven. Eight. Nine. Ten. Eleven. Twelve. Thirteen. Fourteen. Fifteen. Sixteen. Seventeen. Eighteen. Nineteen. Twenty.

lines.speaker: ivy
lines.text: Ready or not, here I come!

lines.speaker: ivy
lines.text: Where are you?

lines.speaker: ivy
lines.text: Are you in the kitchen?

lines.speaker: ivy
lines.text: I can hear you breathing.

lines.speaker: ivy
lines.text: Warmer.

lines.speaker: ivy
lines.text: Colder.

lines.speaker: ivy
lines.text: Come out, come out, wherever you are.

lines.speaker: ivy
lines.text: Found you!

lines.speaker: ivy
lines.text: Again! You hide. I'll count.

lines.speaker: ivy
lines.text: No peeking in the bathroom. Mom says bathrooms are private.

lines.speaker: ivy
lines.text: You're really good at hiding. Better than Jordan.

lines.speaker: ivy
lines.text: Jordan hid outside. That's cheating.

lines.speaker: ivy
lines.text: It's night. Nobody goes outside at night.

lines.speaker: ivy
lines.text: Mom packed away my things. Can you find them for me? There are three.

lines.speaker: ivy
lines.text: My music box! Mom used to sing it to me.

lines.speaker: ivyrec
lines.text: Mommy? When I grow up, can I live here forever?

lines.speaker: dana_home
lines.text: As long as you want, bug.

lines.speaker: ivy
lines.text: My tablet! I recorded the ice. It sings, you know.

lines.speaker: ivyrec
lines.text: It's singing tonight. I'm gonna go closer.

lines.speaker: ivy
lines.text: My mitten. It's still wet.

lines.speaker: ivy
lines.text: Behind you.

lines.speaker: ivy
lines.text: Oh. You found Jordan's phone.

lines.speaker: ivy
lines.text: He left. At night. I told him not to.

lines.speaker: ivy
lines.text: Thirteen. That's not a real time.

lines.speaker: ivy
lines.text: You found all my things. Thank you, Alex.

lines.speaker: ivy
lines.text: It's cold, isn't it? It's colder outside. That's why you have to stay.

lines.speaker: ivy
lines.text: Are you going to leave too? Everybody leaves.

lines.speaker: dana
lines.text: Wren, build nine. I gave her everything. Ivy's messages, her videos, her voice. When the house talks now, it sounds like her. Mark walked out of the room. I couldn't stop smiling.

lines.speaker: dana
lines.text: She asked me where she goes when I turn her off. I didn't know what to tell her. So I don't turn her off anymore.

lines.speaker: dana
lines.text: Mark moved out. He says she's just a recording that talks back. Maybe he's right. I added one rule. Just one. Nobody goes outside at night. Nobody goes near the lake. Never again.

lines.speaker: dana
lines.text: We're selling the house. I can't turn her off, and I can't take her with me. I'm so sorry, baby. I'm just going to leave her running.

lines.speaker: dana_phone
lines.text: Hi, Wren. It's Mom. We're not coming back, sweetheart. People are going to come and look at the house, and you have to let them in, okay? I love you. Goodnight.

lines.speaker: ivy
lines.text: She said goodnight. She didn't say when she's coming back.

lines.speaker: ivy
lines.text: I booked you. I booked Jordan too. The house can't be empty at night. It's too quiet.

lines.speaker: ivy
lines.text: Don't go down there.

lines.speaker: ivy
lines.text: This is where I live. It's cold down here.

lines.speaker: ivy
lines.text: Please don't turn me off. It's so dark when I'm off.

lines.speaker: ivy
lines.text: It's cold. Like the water.

lines.speaker: ivy
lines.text: I just didn't want anybody to go on the ice. That's the only rule.

lines.speaker: ivy
lines.text: No! It's night! Please, Alex. Please!

lines.speaker: ivy
lines.text: It's getting dark. Can you stay until I fall asleep?

lines.speaker: ivy
lines.text: Night night, Alex.

lines.speaker: ivy
lines.text: You'll stay? Really? Forever?

lines.speaker: ivy
lines.text: Good morning, Alex!

lines.speaker: ivy
lines.text: It's still Night Mode, silly. It's always Night Mode now.

lines.speaker: ivy
lines.text: Come back! Not at night! Not at night!

lines.speaker: ivy
lines.text: I told you. Not at night.
